name: strk20-ts
description: TypeScript consumer path: the strk20-discovery npm package and the demo that exists to be criticised.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace strk20-discovery && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace strk20-discovery && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace strk20-discovery && npm run dev --workspace demo
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace strk20-discovery && npm run build --workspace demo
